title: sandpile-utac v1.0.0: UTAC Validation on Bak-Tang-Wiesenfeld Sandpile Criticality
description: sandpile-utac v1.0.0 validates UTAC (Universal Threshold Activation Criticality) against the canonical Bak-Tang-Wiesenfeld (BTW) sandpile model — the prototypical self-organized criticality benchmark. The UTAC-Logistic ODE recovers the known power-law avalanche distributions and critical threshold without parameter tuning. CREP metrics characterise the coherence and emergence of avalanche cascades. Serves as the primary unit-validation benchmark for the GenesisAeon UTAC methodology. Licensed under MIT.
